name: 迷你隐藏单镜头行车记录仪款

category.leaf: 迷你隐藏式单镜头行车记录仪

description: 暗色鎏金科技风，迷你隐藏机身，从取证痛点到信任收口的全链路套图

styleLock.direction: premium dark tech automotive electronics commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep black tech stage #0B0D10 with a subtle square-grid wall for hero, pain and CTA screens; smooth light neutral grey #F2F3F5 studio board for benefit, detail and trust screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: controlled studio lighting with a cool-white key, subtle warm gold rim light, soft contact shadows and gentle controlled speculars on glossy black shells
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte dark round podium with one thin gold trim ring, smooth light-grey studio board, glossy black product shell
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines; short headlines with one sub-line, all Chinese wrapped in 「」
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and thin leader lines, single gold #C9A063 accent, low complexity
styleLock.presentationRules: stable straight-on and slight 3/4 product angles; the compact device must read as the same object across the set; stable scale and centering
noDrift: no readable license plates, road signage or faces in any footage area
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-tech automotive electronics visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep black stage #0B0D10, light neutral grey #F2F3F5, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one gold accent #C9A063; controlled studio lighting with a cool-white key, subtle warm gold rim light and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with Chinese text in 「」; consistent rounded info labels and thin-line icons in the gold accent; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable straight-on and slight 3/4 product angles and scale; any driving or road view stays generic with no readable license plates, no road signage and no faces; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 暗色展台配鎏金圈起势，第一眼立住高级科技感赢得点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a very slight upward tilt, full product visible, centered
shots.lighting: cool-white key from the upper front, subtle warm gold rim light from behind, soft contact shadow, controlled specular on the glossy shell
shots.props: one round matte dark podium with a single thin gold trim ring
shots.textZone: top center headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF with one short sub-line 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: Product hero shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view with a very slight upward tilt, the full product centered on a round matte dark podium trimmed with one thin gold ring, against a deep black wall of subtle square grid panels #0B0D10, the product with its podium filling 50-60% of the frame in the lower two thirds. Cool-white key light from the upper front, a subtle warm gold rim light from behind, a soft contact shadow grounding the product and a controlled specular highlight on the glossy shell. Top center of the frame carries one headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF with one short sub-line 「{callout_1}」, completing one balanced composition. Commercial automotive electronics quality. Negative: no brand names, no logos, no model codes, no text printed on the product beyond the reference, no readable license plates, no watermark, no extra text, no clutter, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 浅灰底一秒讲清迷你易隐藏的核心利益，附三个图标卖点
shots.camera: slight 3/4 view from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the compact body, product on the right third
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light from the upper front, soft contact shadow
shots.props: three thin-line gold icon chips in a row
shots.textZone: left side: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D, one sub-line 「{callout_1}」, and three icon chips labeled 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown at a slight 3/4 view from a high 45-degree angle looking down, placed on the right third of a smooth light-grey studio board #F2F3F5 and filling 50-60% of the frame. Bright even high-key studio light from the upper front with a soft contact shadow. The left side carries one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D, one short sub-line 「{callout_1}」, and a row of three thin-line icon chips in gold #C9A063 labeled 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」, so text and product balance into one finished layout. Negative: no invented performance numbers, no brand marks, no dense body text, no more than one core claim, no props covering the product, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 用空白的取证画面格放大无记录就没有证据的焦虑
shots.camera: straight-on flat infographic layout, no perspective
shots.lighting: flat even graphic lighting, slightly darker header band for weight
shots.background: deep black ground #0B0D10 with a darker header band
shots.props: a 2x2 grid of four empty white playback frames with thin light borders
shots.productOccupancy: 5-8% (a small {product} centered below the grid as the quiet answer)
shots.whitespace: none; the deep black ground itself frames the grid as quiet dark spacing
shots.textZone: header band: one pain headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF with one sub-line 「{callout_2}」; each frame captioned below by one short label 「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point screen about driving disputes without evidence. {product} appears only once, small and centered below the grid as the quiet answer. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on flat infographic layout on a deep black ground #0B0D10: a darker header band carries one short pain headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one sub-line 「{callout_2}」; below it a 2x2 grid of four completely empty white playback frames with thin light borders, each frame captioned underneath by one short label 「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF, the whole grid centered as one balanced layout with even dark margins. The frames stay blank — they stand for missing recorded evidence. The small product at the bottom occupies 5-8%. Negative: no real footage inside the frames, no readable license plates, no road signs or place names, no faces, no fabricated claims or statistics, no brand marks, no watermark, no extra text.

shots.intent: 后视镜后方隐蔽安装的代入感，暗示不挡视线日常无感
shots.camera: cabin eye-level at a slight 3/4 angle, handheld candid feel, product mounted at the windshield behind the rearview mirror area
shots.lighting: soft daylight 5500K coming through the windshield from the front, gentle glass reflections, natural interior falloff
shots.background: generic unbranded car cabin with a softly blurred open road visible through the windshield
shots.props: silhouette of a rearview mirror and a clean dashboard, no badges
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} mounted small and discreet at the windshield behind the rearview mirror area inside a generic unbranded car. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from the cabin at eye-level with a slight 3/4 angle and a candid handheld feel; through the windshield a softly blurred open road in daylight, no nearby vehicles. Soft daylight 5500K from the front, gentle glass reflections, natural interior falloff over dark grey cabin trim #3A3D42, plausible contact between mount and glass. The mounted device and mirror area fill 30-40% of the frame as the clear focal point, with the road view reading as one airy uncluttered composition. No text in frame. Negative: no readable license plates, no road signs or place names, no recognizable faces, no brand badges or steering-wheel logos, no hands covering the product, no cluttered cabin, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 侧视爆炸图展示镜头内部结构，用光学构造背书成像

shots.lighting: cool raking side light from the right revealing glass edges, controlled highlights, deep clean shadows
shots.props: a receding row of translucent blank lens elements floating left from the body, thin leader lines to two label chips
shots.whitespace: none; the floating elements and leader lines carry the whole frame
shots.textZone: top-left one claim line 「{selling_point_2}」 in #FFFFFF; two label chips 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 at the leader-line ends
shots.promptTemplate: Exploded lens-structure detail of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile with the body on the right of a matte charcoal stage #0B0D10, a receding row of translucent blank lens elements floating leftward out of the barrel, each connected by thin leader lines to two label chips 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」, so the exploded row spans the frame and fills 55-60% with the structure as the whole point. Cool raking side light from the right reveals the polished glass edges and glossy shell with controlled highlights. One claim line 「{selling_point_2}」 in #FFFFFF sits at the top left above the elements. Negative: no invented lens counts or optical specs, no readable text on the lens ring, no blurry subject, no brand marks, no duplicated glass elements, no extra text, no watermark.

The full body shown at a 3/4 rear-side angle slightly above eye-level on pure white #FFFFFF, filling 65-75% of the frame, with four thin grey leader lines running from the lens bezel, the side ports, the card slot and the speaker holes to four rounded label chips 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 in #2D2D2D placed just outside the body, completing one annotated composition. Two matched panels with identical frontal through-windshield framing and identical camera height: left panel a bright daylight road view 5500K, right panel the same road at night under dim street lighting, both softly blurred and generic, separated by a thin dark divider; the two panels together fill the majority of the frame. Below the panels one small centered {product} thumbnail on deep black #0B0D10 occupying 5-10%. One short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF on quiet caption strips under each panel, and one headline 「{selling_point_3}」 above the panels, so the layout reads as one finished integrated composition. Negative: no readable license plates, no road signs or place names, no faces, no fabricated clarity claims or numbers, no mismatched perspective between panels, no extra text, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 从 7 屏爆款行车记录仪详情长图切片提炼；已剥离机型代号、镜头标环文字、品牌口号横带、会员/二维码促销、全部原文案与蜂窝图表具体标签。分辨率、像素、镜片组数量、尺寸等参数一律改为 {selling_point}/{callout} 文案槽位由使用方填写，未编造任何规格；画面中的行车/录像区域均要求无可辨识车牌、路牌地名与真人面部。第 4 屏蜂窝卖点图的『多重优势』结构与第 2/3 屏浅底卖点合并进 shot-02，保留图标行语法。
